channel.title: Mali - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mali, every source cited.

item.title: Mali street drug sales endanger health
item.description: Health professionals warn of treatment failures and poisonings from unregulated medicines sold without prescriptions.

item.title: Mali launches solidarity month activities
item.description: Mali's solidarity month included training for cancer patients and disabled women, and delivery of maternal health kits.

item.title: Multiple bus robberies on Gao–Intilit road
item.description: Travelers report being robbed and their belongings ransacked on the route between Gao and Intilit.

item.title: Mali's M5-RFP leaders sidelined by military junta
item.description: Former key figures in the ousting of President IBK are now imprisoned, in exile, or out of public life.
